title.narrative: Iraq Social Safety Net Enhancement Project

description.narrative: The project seeks to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of the Ministry of Labor and Social Affairs’ (MOLSA) programs through(i) modernizing and strengthening the Cash Transfer Program’s delivery systems; and (ii) establishing a MOLSA social registry that would be integrated into the National Single Registry.
